WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".amount, "d".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND ("l".date + ("l".duration * INTERVAL '1 month') - INTERVAL '1 day') >= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D')), "totals" AS (SELECT region, SUM(amount) AS "total_approved_amount" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY region) SELECT region, total_approved_amount FROM "totals" WHERE total_approved_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_approved_amount) FROM "totals") LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opening_date", SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".date), "owner_household" AS (SELECT "d".account_id, "c".district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER'), "counterparty_counts" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "outside_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id) SELECT "b".account_id, "b".opening_date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("cp".outside_counterparties, 0) AS "outside_counterparties", "hd".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "hd".a8 AS "district_population", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "hd".a8 DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "borrowing" AS "b" INNER JOIN "owner_household" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "b".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "hd" ON "hd".district_id = "o".home_district_id LEFT JOIN "counterparty_counts" AS "cp" ON "cp".account_id = "b".account_id ORDER BY "hd".a8 DESC, "b".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "od" ON "od".account_id = "a".account_id AND "od".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "od".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "eligible_accounts" AS "ea" ON "ea".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "pair_totals") SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payment_count, total_amount_paid FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t"."k_symbol" = 'SIPO' THEN "t"."amount" ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t"."amount"), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t"."account_id" = "a"."account_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a"."district_id" = "d"."district_id" WHERE "d"."a2" ILIKE '%Pisek%' AND "t"."type" = 'VYDAJ' AND "t"."k_symbol" <> ' ' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "dp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "regional" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG("d".a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG("d".a12)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_unemployment_rate" FROM "eligible_districts" AS "e" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "e".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "ranked_districts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a2 AS "district_name", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "d".a3 ORDER BY "d".a8 DESC, "d".a2 ASC) AS "rn" FROM "eligible_districts" AS "e" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "e".district_id) SELECT "r".region, "r".average_district_salary, "r".average_1996_unemployment_rate, "rd".district_name AS "most_populous_district" FROM "regional" AS "r" INNER JOIN "ranked_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".region = "r".region AND "rd".rn = 1 LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "cl".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "cd".card_type, "d".a2 AS "district", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", MIN("d".a4::BIGINT) OVER (PARTITION BY "cd".card_type) AS "min_inhabitants" FROM "card_districts" AS "cd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cd".district_id) SELECT card_type, district, inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "account_balances" AS (SELECT "ac".account_id, "ac".district_id, "latest".balance FROM "account" AS "ac" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ac".district_id INNER JOIN "target_region" AS "r" ON "r".a3 = "d".a3 INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "ac".account_id AND "t".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest" ON TRUE WHERE "ac".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "ac".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", ROUND(AVG("ab".balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_balance" FROM "account_balances" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "ab".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2) SELECT district_name, accounts_opened, avg_balance, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "account_balances") AS "region_wide_avg_balance", (SELECT district_name FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY avg_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) AS "highest_avg_balance_district" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "a".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_ten_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id FROM "ranked_loans" AS "rl" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "rl".district_id WHERE "rl".rn <= 10), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_yearly_salary", AVG("d".a11) OVER () AS "mean_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "top_ten_districts" AS "t" ON "t".district_id = "d".district_id) SELECT district_name, inhabitants, ROUND(mean_salary::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "district_metrics" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "withdrawal_totals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "standing_order_totals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "total_debit" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "account_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id), "qualified" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "population", "wt".total_withdrawn, "wt".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / "d".a4::NUMERIC AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE("sot".total_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / "ac".account_count AS "avg_order_debit" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "withdrawal_totals" AS "wt" ON "wt".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "account_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "standing_order_totals" AS "sot" ON "sot".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::NUMERIC >= 100000) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant", ROUND(avg_order_debit, 2) AS "average_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "qualified" ORDER BY rank_by_withdrawals_per_inhabitant ASC, district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "tx" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_income", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "region_clients" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, a3 AS "region", a8 AS "inhabitants", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a8 DESC) AS "population_rank", FIRST_VALUE(a2) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a8 DESC) AS "most_populous_name", FIRST_VALUE(a8) OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a8 DESC) AS "most_populous_inhabitants" FROM "district") SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "a".frequency, "account_district".a2 AS "district_name", "account_district".a3 AS "region", CASE WHEN "account_district".district_id = "home_district".district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "is_home_district", "account_district".a12 AS "average_salary", COALESCE("l".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("l".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "rc".client_count AS "clients_in_region", "rd".most_populous_name, "rd".most_populous_inhabitants, "rd".population_rank FROM "disp" AS "dp" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home_district" ON "home_district".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "account_district" ON "account_district".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "region_clients" AS "rc" ON "rc".region = "account_district".a3 INNER JOIN "region_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".district_id = "account_district".district_id WHERE "dp".client_id = 3541 ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::TEXT AS "year", "al".district_id, COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "amount_lent", SUM("al".amount_lent)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "al".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date), "al".district_id) SELECT year, SUM(accounts_opened) AS "accounts_opened", SUM(amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG(lent_per_account), 2) AS "average_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "district_year" GROUP BY year ORDER BY year ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT loan_id, account_id, amount, date FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE rn <= 10), "end_of_day" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, "t".date, "t".balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "t".account_id, "t".date ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC) AS "rn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "top_loans" AS "tl" ON "tl".account_id = "t".account_id AND "tl".date = "t".date) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "tl".amount AS "approved_amount", "tl".date AS "approval_date", "eod".balance AS "end_of_day_balance" FROM "top_loans" AS "tl" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "tl".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "end_of_day" AS "eod" ON "eod".account_id = "tl".account_id AND "eod".date = "tl".date AND "eod".rn = 1 ORDER BY "tl".amount DESC, "tl".date ASC, "tl".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_clients" AS (SELECT "c"."client_id", "c"."gender", "c"."birth_date", "ca"."type" AS "card_type", "ca"."issued", "d"."a2" AS "district_name", "d"."a11" AS "district_average_salary", "disp"."account_id" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "disp" ON "disp"."disp_id" = "ca"."disp_id" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c"."client_id" = "disp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "c"."district_id" WHERE "ca"."issued" >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca"."issued" < DATE '1995-01-01'), "client_profile" AS (SELECT "cc"."client_id", "cc"."gender", "cc"."birth_date", "cc".card_type, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cc"."issued")::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "cc"."birth_date")::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", COUNT("l"."loan_id") AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE(SUM("l"."amount"), 0) AS "total_amount_borrowed", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary FROM "card_clients" AS "cc" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l"."account_id" = "cc"."account_id" GROUP BY "cc"."client_id", "cc"."gender", "cc"."birth_date", "cc".card_type, "cc"."issued", "cc".district_name, "cc".district_average_salary) SELECT "client_id", "gender", "birth_date", card_type, age_at_issue, number_of_loans, total_amount_borrowed, CASE WHEN number_of_loans > 0 AND age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN number_of_loans > 0 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "gender" ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "client_profile" ORDER BY "client_id" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol = ' ' GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".account_id = 4907 AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "k_symbol" = 'UROK' THEN amount WHEN "k_symbol" = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM "disp" WHERE client_id = 2823 AND type = 'OWNER' LIMIT 1) AND date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "k_symbol" IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "region_districts" AS (SELECT district_id, a2 AS "district", a3 AS "region", a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "district"), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "rd".region, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "region_districts" AS "rd3" ON "rd3".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "rd3".region = "rd".region) AS "regional_loan_count", ROUND(AVG("rd".average_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "region_avg_salary" FROM "region_districts" AS "rd" GROUP BY "rd".region), "txn_stats" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "female_loans" AS (SELECT "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "a".account_id, "rd".district, "rd".region FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".client_id = "c".client_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "dp".account_id INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "region_districts" AS "rd" ON "rd".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F' AND "dp".type = 'OWNER'), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "female_loans") SELECT "r".client_id, "r".amount AS "loan_amount", "r".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("r".payments * "r".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("r".payments * "r".duration - "r".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "r".status AS "loan_status", "r".district, "r".region, COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "r".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0) > "r".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rs".regional_loan_count, "rs".region_avg_salary, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "r".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "completed_age" FROM "ranked" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "txn_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "r".account_id INNER JOIN "region_stats" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "r".region WHERE "r".amount_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "r".amount DESC, "r".client_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".account_id FROM "loan" AS "l" WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "district_accounts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region_name", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", COUNT(DISTINCT "qa".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "qa".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a3, "d".a4), "regional_totals" AS (SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM(inhabitants) AS "combined_population", SUM(account_count) AS "account_count" FROM "district_accounts" GROUP BY region_name), "top_region" AS (SELECT region_name, district_count, combined_population, account_count FROM "regional_totals" ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "da".district_name, "da".region_name, "tr".district_count, "tr".combined_population, "tr".account_count AS "total_accounts" FROM "top_region" AS "tr" INNER JOIN "district_accounts" AS "da" ON "da".region_name = "tr".region_name ORDER BY "da".district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "monthly_accounts_1997" AS (SELECT account_id, district_id FROM "account" WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE' AND date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date < DATE '1998-01-01'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a11 FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "monthly_accounts_1997" AS "m" ON "m".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000 GROUP BY "d".district_id, "d".a11) SELECT COUNT(*) AS "monthly_statement_accounts_opened", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "qualifying_districts") AS "district_count", ROUND((SELECT AVG(a11)::NUMERIC FROM "qualifying_districts"), 2) AS "average_salary" FROM "monthly_accounts_1997" AS "m" INNER JOIN "qualifying_districts" AS "q" ON "q".district_id = "m".district_id LIMIT 501

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "dp".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "transaction_totals" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT ("t".bank, "t".account)) FILTER (WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loan_totals" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id) SELECT "a".account_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tt".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("lt".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("tt".external_counterparties, 0) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ga".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "transaction_totals" AS "tt" ON "tt".account_id = "a".account_id LEFT JOIN "loan_totals" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "a".account_id ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, "a".account_id ASC LIMIT 60 OFFSET 30

WITH "branch_accounts" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Tabor' AND "a".date <= DATE '1996-12-31'), "owner_info" AS (SELECT "ba".account_id, "c".gender, "c".birth_date FROM "branch_accounts" AS "ba" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id), "card_counts" AS (SELECT "dp".account_id, COUNT("cd".card_id) AS "card_count" FROM "branch_accounts" AS "ba" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "ba".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "cd" ON "cd".disp_id = "dp".disp_id WHERE "cd".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "dp".account_id), "loan_stats" AS (SELECT "ba".account_id, COUNT("l".loan_id) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN COUNT("l".loan_id) = 0 THEN 'no loan' WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted' WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN 'repaying' ELSE 'paid off' END AS "loan_standing" FROM "branch_accounts" AS "ba" LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "l".date <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY "ba".account_id), "activity" AS (SELECT "ba".account_id, COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM'), 0) AS "money_in", COALESCE(SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER')), 0) AS "money_out", COALESCE(MAX("t".balance), 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "branch_accounts" AS "ba" LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "ba".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "ba".account_id), "profile" AS (SELECT "ba".account_id, "ba".opened_date, "oi".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "oi".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age", COALESCE("cc".card_count, 0) AS "card_count", "ls".loan_count, "ls".loan_standing, "act".transaction_count, "act".money_in, "act".money_out, "act".peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY "act".peak_balance DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "branch_accounts" AS "ba" INNER JOIN "owner_info" AS "oi" ON "oi".account_id = "ba".account_id LEFT JOIN "card_counts" AS "cc" ON "cc".account_id = "ba".account_id INNER JOIN "loan_stats" AS "ls" ON "ls".account_id = "ba".account_id INNER JOIN "activity" AS SELECT "r".year, "r".time AS "scheduled_start_time", "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND "res".position = 2 AND "r".time = (SELECT MIN("r2".time) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND "r2".year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009) ORDER BY "r".year DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) < 98.000 LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time::TIME = TIME '20:00:00' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND "r".fastestlapspeed <> '' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX(CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC)) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".driverid) FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "r".statusid WHERE "ra".year = 1962 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "res".position IS NOT NULL)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "percentage" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "res".raceid WHERE "ra".year = 1957 AND "ra".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(event_expense) FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_expense" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "x".expense_date::DATE) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2019 THEN "b".spent WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) = 2020 THEN -"b".spent ELSE 0 END) AS "total_spent_2019_minus_2020" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) IN (2019, 2020) LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "kickoff".spent / "october".spent AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "kickoff" INNER JOIN "event" AS "kickoff_event" ON "kickoff".link_to_event = "kickoff_event".event_id CROSS JOIN "budget" AS "october" INNER JOIN "event" AS "october_event" ON "october".link_to_event = "october_event".event_id WHERE "kickoff".category = 'Advertisement' AND "kickoff_event".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' AND "october".category = 'Advertisement' AND "october_event".event_name = 'October Meeting' LIMIT 501

WITH "ratios" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "spending_ratio" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "ranked" AS (SELECT event_id, event_name, spending_ratio, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY spending_ratio DESC) AS "ratio_rank" FROM "ratios") SELECT event_name FROM "ranked" WHERE ratio_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS soccer_attendance, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_attendance)::numeric, 1) FROM (SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a2.link_to_member) AS event_attendance FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a2 ON a2.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY e.event_id) fall_events) AS fall_2019_average, CASE WHEN COUNT(a.link_to_member) > (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_attendance)::numeric, 1) FROM (SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a2.link_to_member) AS event_attendance FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a2 ON a2.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY e.event_id) fall_events) THEN 'more' WHEN COUNT(a.link_to_member) < (SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_attendance)::numeric, 1) FROM (SELECT e.event_id, COUNT(a2.link_to_member) AS event_attendance FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a2 ON a2.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND e.event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY e.event_id) fall_events) THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS verdict FROM event e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'Women's Soccer' GROUP BY e.event_id

WITH "college_departments" AS (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'), "aggregated" AS (SELECT "d".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_id) AS "offered_count", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "ma".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "ma".major_name ASC) AS "offered", STRING_AGG(DISTINCT "ma".major_name, ', ' ORDER BY "ma".major_name ASC) FILTER (WHERE "m".member_id IS NOT NULL) AS "held", COUNT("m".member_id) AS "member_count" FROM "college_departments" AS "d" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma".department = "d".department LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "d".department) SELECT department, offered AS "majors_offered", held AS "majors_held", ROUND(member_count::NUMERIC / offered_count, 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "aggregated" ORDER BY department ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "event_counts" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "budget_totals" AS (SELECT "e".type, SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type) SELECT "ec".type AS "event_type", "ec".members_attended, COALESCE("bt".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_budgeted_dollars" FROM "event_counts" AS "ec" LEFT JOIN "budget_totals" AS "bt" ON "bt".type = "ec".type ORDER BY "ec".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "mj".department AS "department", COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "mj" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "mj".major_id AND "m".position = 'Member' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "attendance") AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "mj".college = 'College of Engineering' AND ("m".member_id IS NULL OR "a".link_to_member IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY "mj".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e".link_to_member INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("i".amount) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "i".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' AND "e".type = 'Game' AND "e".event_name ILIKE '%Football%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college = (SELECT "tyler_major".college FROM "member" AS "tyler" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tyler_major" ON "tyler".link_to_major = "tyler_major".major_id WHERE "tyler".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tyler".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" WHERE "enrolled".link_to_major = "m".major_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_attendees_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location ORDER BY "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "mj".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "mj".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX(major_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) AS "major_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "e2".event_id = "a2".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj2" ON "mj2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj2".major_name) AS "counts") ORDER BY "mj".major_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".member_id IS NULL) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "a".major_id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "group_name", ROUND(AVG(event_count), 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT("a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_counts" GROUP BY CASE WHEN position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT kind) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description = 'Water, Cookies' THEN 'Water' WHEN expense_description = 'Water, cookies, chips' THEN 'Water' WHEN expense_description = 'Water, chips, cookies' THEN 'Water' WHEN expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'Water' WHEN expense_description = 'Pizza' THEN 'Pizza' WHEN expense_description = 'Posters' THEN 'Posters' WHEN expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' THEN 'Posters' WHEN expense_description = 'Parking' THEN 'Parking' WHEN expense_description = 'Club shirts' THEN 'shirts' WHEN expense_description = 'Travel Mug' THEN 'Mug' WHEN expense_description = 'Alumni Glass' THEN 'Glass' WHEN expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'Donuts' END AS "kind" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "budget" ON "expense".link_to_budget = "budget".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" ON "budget".link_to_event = "event".event_id WHERE "budget".remaining < 0 AND "event".event_date >= '2019-08-01' AND "event".event_date < '2020-01-01') AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT "ev".event_name, TO_CHAR(ROUND(COALESCE("water".total_water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "attendance_counts".attendee_count, 2), 'FM999999990.00') AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "attendance_counts" ON "attendance_counts".link_to_event = "ev".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("ex".cost) AS "total_water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "ex".expense_description ILIKE 'Water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "water" ON "water".link_to_event = "ev".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'in college' ELSE 'not in college' END AS "membership_group", COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences' THEN 'in college' ELSE 'not in college' END LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "b2".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "b2".link_to_event = "e".event_id) AND "b".amount = (SELECT MAX("b3".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b3" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x3" ON "x3".link_to_budget = "b3".budget_id WHERE "x3".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" WHERE "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e2".link_to_member WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type LIMIT 501

WITH "college_major_counts" AS (SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_id) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college), "top_count" AS (SELECT MAX(number_of_majors) AS "max_number_of_majors" FROM "college_major_counts") SELECT "c".college, "c".number_of_majors FROM "college_major_counts" AS "c" INNER JOIN "top_count" AS "t" ON "c".number_of_majors = "t".max_number_of_majors ORDER BY "c".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND TO_DATE("e".event_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < DATE '2019-10-01' AND "x".expense_description = 'Pizza' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event AS "event_id", COUNT(*) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "et".event_name FROM "event_totals" AS "et" LEFT JOIN "purchase_counts" AS "pc" ON "pc".event_id = "et".event_id WHERE "et".total_spending <= "et".total_budget ORDER BY COALESCE("pc".purchases, 0) DESC, "et".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "type_attendance" AS (SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date::DATE >= DATE '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date::DATE < DATE '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type), "ranked" AS (SELECT type, members_attended, MAX(members_attended) OVER () AS "max_members" FROM "type_attendance") SELECT type, members_attended FROM "ranked" WHERE members_attended = max_members LIMIT 501

SELECT "expense".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "budget" ON "expense".link_to_budget = "budget".budget_id WHERE "budget".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "expense".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "expense".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "b".category, "e".expense_description AS "item_name", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "v" ON "b".link_to_event = "v".event_id WHERE "v".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' GROUP BY "b".category, "e".expense_description ORDER BY "b".category ASC, item_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

WITH "eye_colour_counts" AS (SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'N/A' GROUP BY "c".colour) SELECT eye_colour, hero_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hero_count DESC) AS "rank" FROM "eye_colour_counts" ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "s".publisher_id = "pub".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_published_by_marvel" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'DC Comics' END AS "publisher_name", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') ORDER BY "s".full_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour IS NOT NULL AND "hair".colour IS NOT NULL AND "skin".colour IS NOT NULL AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour ILIKE 'Blue') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "dc".hero_count > "marvel".hero_count THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN "marvel".hero_count > "dc".hero_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS("dc".hero_count - "marvel".hero_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc" CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' GROUP BY "sp".power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM "counts" WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_ab".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_ab" ON "ha_ab".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_ab" ON "a_ab".id = "ha_ab".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a_ab".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "hulk_strength".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_strength" ON "hulk_strength".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "strength_attr" ON "strength_attr".id = "hulk_strength".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "strength_attr".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT id, height_cm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC, id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL), "cutoff" AS (SELECT MIN(height_cm) AS "min_height" FROM "ranked" WHERE rn <= 10), "tallest" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" CROSS JOIN "cutoff" AS "c" WHERE "s".height_cm >= "c".min_height) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "tallest" AS "t" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "t".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race IN ('God', 'Eternal') AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "ab".race_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".race_id = "ab".race_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "r".id IN (SELECT "s2".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "s2" LEFT JOIN "gender" AS "g2" ON "g2".id = "s2".gender_id WHERE "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "s2".race_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "g2".gender = 'Female') = 0) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "publisher_hero".id) FROM "superhero" AS "blackwulf" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "publisher_hero" ON "publisher_hero".publisher_id = "blackwulf".publisher_id WHERE "blackwulf".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "blackwulf".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "publisher_hero".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL AND "publisher_hero".eye_colour_id IN (SELECT "other_hero".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "other_hero" WHERE "other_hero".publisher_id IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero".publisher_id <> "blackwulf".publisher_id AND "other_hero".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id WHERE "s".publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND "r".race IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' GROUP BY race HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(race_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "race_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "s2".race_id = "r2".id WHERE "s2".publisher_id = (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AND "r2".race IS NOT NULL AND "r2".race <> '-' GROUP BY "r2".race) AS "counts") LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("x".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "ha".hero_id, "ha".attribute_value FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ha".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("power_counts".power_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" GROUP BY hero_id) AS "power_counts" ON "power_counts".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND POSITION(' ' IN BTRIM("s".full_name)) > 0 GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(height_cm) FILTER (WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "publisher" ON "superhero".publisher_id = "publisher".id WHERE "publisher".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_hp" ON "shared_hp".power_id = "target_hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "shared_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".id <> "target".id AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "sp".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
