SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".thrombosis <> 0 LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "e".id IS NOT NULL AND "l".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')), "scored" AS (SELECT "e".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id) SELECT id, anti_rnp_titer FROM "scored" WHERE anti_rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(anti_rnp_titer) FROM "scored") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lp" ON "lp".id = "p".id AND "lp".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "lr" ON "lr".id = "p".id AND "lr".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' LIMIT 501

SELECT sex, ROUND(AVG(test_date_count), 2) AS "avg_laboratory_test_dates" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) AS "test_date_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) AS "patient_counts" GROUP BY sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, dna, MAX(dna) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "max_dna" FROM "eligible") SELECT id, date, dna FROM "ranked" WHERE dna = max_dna ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id AND "h".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id AND "r".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

WITH "target_patients" AS (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])RA([,[:space:]]|$)' AND diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])SJS([,[:space:]]|$)' AND diagnosis !~ 'susp' AND diagnosis !~ '^[[:space:]]*(RA[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*RA)[[:space:]]*$'), "normal_ids" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NOT NULL) AS "had_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "n".id IS NULL) AS "never_had_normal_platelet_result" FROM "target_patients" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "normal_ids" AS "n" ON "n".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "birthday" >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE "diagnosis" IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "woman_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), "per_patient" AS (SELECT id, BOOL_OR(rnp <> 'negative') AS "has_positive", BOOL_OR(rnp NOT IN ('negative', '0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64')) AS "has_elevated" FROM "woman_results" GROUP BY id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "per_patient" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=1000', '>=300')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e"."Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "e"."Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND "e".thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "diagnosis" ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MIN("Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" GROUP BY id) AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l"."U-PRO"::INTEGER >= 300) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_cre_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "l".id, "l"."T-CHO", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "p".admission ORDER BY "l"."T-CHO" DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "T-CHO", admission, id FROM "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY CASE admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) AS "level" FROM "eligible") SELECT DISTINCT "e".id, "e".rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "eligible" AS "e" CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "e".rnp::INTEGER = "h".level LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND hct IS NOT NULL AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" IN ('4')) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '+1(30)', '100', '+2(100)', '300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND ("e".kct IS NULL OR "e".kct <> '+') AND ("e".rvvt IS NULL OR "e".rvvt <> '+') AND ("e".lac IS NULL OR "e".lac <> '+') LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_sample" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_sc170" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, sc170 FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "ls".id FROM "latest_sample" AS "ls" INNER JOIN "latest_sc170" AS "s" ON "s".id = "ls".id WHERE "ls".latest_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ssa".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "ssa" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein" ON "protein".id = "ssa".id WHERE "ssa".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "ssa".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "protein"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "protein"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("rnp"::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE "cre" < 1.5 AND "rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id AS "patient_id", "l".date AS "laboratory_test_date", "l".rnp AS "anti_ribonuclear_protein_reading" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN "l".id END) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hgb < 10 GROUP BY id) AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) SELECT id, sex, highest_rnp FROM "eligible" WHERE highest_rnp = (SELECT MAX(highest_rnp) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

WITH "first_lab" AS (SELECT id, got, rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date ASC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory") SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_lab" WHERE rn = 1 AND got < 60 AND CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::INTEGER > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT id, date, "U-PRO", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "r".date, "r"."U-PRO" FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rn = 1 LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('16', '64', '256')), "patient_max" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "max_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "patient_max" AS "m" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "m".id ORDER BY "m".max_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MM-DD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MM-DD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([,[:space:]]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) AS "patients_with_rnp_at_least_4", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL OR "l".rnp IS NULL OR "l".rnp !~ '^[0-9]+$' OR "l".rnp::INTEGER < 4) AS "patients_without_rnp_at_least_4" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_labs" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".igg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l") SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "ranked_labs" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "r".rn = 1 AND "r".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "sle" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis = 'SLE'), "numeric_results" AS (SELECT "sle".id, "sle".diagnosis, "laboratory".dna, CAST("laboratory".dna AS NUMERIC) AS "numeric_dna" FROM "sle" INNER JOIN "laboratory" ON "laboratory".id = "sle".id WHERE "laboratory".dna <> '' AND translate("laboratory".dna, '0123456789.', '') = ''), "maxima" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis, dna, numeric_dna, MAX(numeric_dna) OVER (PARTITION BY id) AS "patient_max", MAX(numeric_dna) OVER () AS "overall_max" FROM "numeric_results") SELECT id, diagnosis, dna AS "highest_anti_dna_test_result" FROM "maxima" WHERE numeric_dna = patient_max AND patient_max = overall_max LIMIT 501

WITH "most_recent" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "most_recent" AS "m" ON "l".id = "m".id AND "l".date = "m".latest_date WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "latest_results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, "l".cpk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ranked" WHERE rn = 1 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::INTEGER > 64 AND cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "ldh_lab" ON "ldh_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "ldh_lab".ldh >= 500 AND "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+2(100)') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' ORDER BY "p".birthday ASC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' ORDER BY ("p"."First Date" - "p".birthday) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

WITH "alt_by_patient" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, BOOL_OR("l".gpt >= 60) AS "has_abnormal_alt" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex) SELECT CASE WHEN sex = 'M' THEN 'male' ELSE 'female' END AS "sex", COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "alt_by_patient" WHERE sex IN ('M', 'F') AND has_abnormal_alt IS NOT TRUE GROUP BY sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".sm IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY "l".id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) AS "normal_sm" WHERE "normal_sm".id IN (SELECT "l2".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)')) AND "normal_sm".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" GROUP BY "e".id HAVING MIN("e".thrombosis) = 0 AND MAX("e".thrombosis) = 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rbc_lab" ON "rbc_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_lab" ON "rnp_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("rbc_lab".rbc <= 3.5 OR "rbc_lab".rbc >= 6.0) AND "rnp_lab".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') + COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F'), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('0', '-') AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age("l".date, "p".birthday)) < 50 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'i') AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 's') AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_atom_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "bond_group", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "label" = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "label" = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM (SELECT "m"."molecule_id", "m"."label", CASE WHEN COUNT("b"."bond_id") FILTER (WHERE "b"."bond_type" <> '-') = 0 THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b"."molecule_id" = "m"."molecule_id" GROUP BY "m"."molecule_id", "m"."label") AS "molecule_groups" GROUP BY "bond_group" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type = '=' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_plus_elements" AS (SELECT "pa".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "pa".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "plus_atoms" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "pa".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "pa".atom_id GROUP BY "pa".element), "most_common" AS (SELECT element, bonded_atom_count FROM "bonded_plus_elements" WHERE bonded_atom_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_atom_count) FROM "bonded_plus_elements")) SELECT "mc".element, ROUND(100.0 * "mc".bonded_atom_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "plus_atoms"), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "most_common" AS "mc" LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond type", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "b" ON "b".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "b".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) AS "eligible" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END) FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#'), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "rare_elements" AS (SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) = 1), "qualifying_molecules" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element WHERE "m".label = '+') SELECT "q".molecule_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "qualifying_molecules" AS "q" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "q".molecule_id ORDER BY "q".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT rank, molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "yt" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "yt".molecule_id = "h".molecule_id AND "h".element = 'h' INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON ("c".atom_id = "h".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "h".atom_id) INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other" ON "other".atom_id = CASE WHEN "c".atom_id = "h".atom_id THEN "c".atom_id2 ELSE "c".atom_id END WHERE "yt".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_degrees" LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'c' THEN "a2".element ELSE "a1".element END AS "element", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id AND "a2".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id AND (("a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element <> 'c') OR ("a1".element <> 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c')) GROUP BY CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'c' THEN "a2".element ELSE "a1".element END ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element), GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type) SELECT "bc".bond_kind, "bc".bond_count, "bc".element_pair_count, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond_counts" AS "bc" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' ORDER BY "bc".bond_count DESC, "bc".bond_kind ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a".atom_id, "a".element HAVING BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-')) AS "saturated" GROUP BY element ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
